The '''Master of Arms''' is the title of the man in charge of training the aspiring [[Warders]] in [[Tar Valon]].

[[Coulin]], Master of Arms to [[Siuan Sanche]]{{ref/book|3|16}} was the only known Master of Arms. He was killed by [[Gawyn Trakand]] during the coup that triggered the [[White Tower Schism]].{{ref/book|4|47}}
